name: Nanyang Technological University
summary: Singapore university with colleges of Engineering, Business, Science, Humanities and a medical school; one intake a year, from late July.

ib.text: You can apply before IB results are out but must give NTU direct IBO transcript access. Engineering asks HL Maths plus an HL science; business SL Maths; humanities good SL English. AA and AI both count.

dates.label: IB applications close; May sitters send final results within 3 days of release
Latest day to give NTU access to your IBO transcript (May 2027 session: end of June)

programmes.name: Materials Engineering
programmes.about: A four-year engineering degree that combines the fundamental sciences with engineering; strong students can be offered an accelerated 3.5-year route after first year.
programmes.ib: HL Mathematics and HL Physics, Chemistry or Biology; SL Physics (or equivalent) if you did not take HL Physics. Maths AA and AI are both accepted.

needs.note: Only if you did not take HL Physics

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on predicted IB results, then final results in July; NTU publishes no IB grade profile.

flagshipSource.title: Materials Engineering (School of Materials Science and Engineering): sciences plus engineering

programmes.name: Business
programmes.about: A four-year business degree at Nanyang Business School designed for depth, breadth, flexibility and global exposure, with minors and second majors such as Entrepreneurship.
programmes.ib: SL Mathematics (Maths AA or AI); admission is on a selective basis. NTU's prerequisite list shows 3 years where the programme page says four.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on predicted IB results, then final results in July; some applicants may be called for a test or interview.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Business at Nanyang Business School: depth, breadth, flexibility and global exposure

faculties.name: College of Engineering
faculties.line: HL Mathematics and an HL science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Computer Science) for most degrees.

faculties.name: College of Science
faculties.line: Chemistry and Biological Chemistry needs HL Chemistry and HL Maths or Physics; Biological Sciences also lists HL science.

faculties.name: College of Business
faculties.line: SL Mathematics for Accountancy and Business; admission is on a selective basis.

faculties.name: College of Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences
faculties.line: A good grade in SL English for most degrees; Art, Design and Media needs a portfolio and creative project.

faculties.name: Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine
faculties.line: HL Chemistry and HL Biology or Physics, a BMAT result and referee reports; May 2027 sitters cannot use the July-results route.

notes: EU students can get the MOE Tuition Grant, which cuts the fee but requires you to work for a Singapore entity for three years after graduating.
NTU offers one intake a year and expects direct IBO access to your transcript; it will not process an application without it.
May 2027 sitters can send final IB results within three days of release in July, except for Medicine, Arts (Academic Discipline and Education) and Science (Academic Disciplines and Education).
